en.quote: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him, Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
en.riddle: Whoso is thoughtless, let him turn in hither
en.speaker: she saith to him

he.quote: מִי-פֶתִי, יָסֻר הֵנָּה וַחֲסַר-לֵב וְאָמְרָה לּֽוֹ מַֽיִם-גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ וְלֶחֶם סְתָרִים יִנְעָֽם
he.speaker: וְאָמְרָה לּוֹ
